// Doubles firebase with `jest.doMock` (scoped, paired with resetModules) and
// never with the hoisted `jest.mock`. It reaches no emulator.
const logger = require('../../src/utils/loggerInstance');

test('production logger writes through a doubled db', () => {
  jest.resetModules();
  jest.doMock('../../src/utils/firebase', () => ({ db: { doc: () => ({ set: () => {} }) } }));
  const prod = require('../../src/utils/loggerInstance');
  expect(prod).toBeDefined();
  expect(logger).toBeDefined();
});
